notes.title: What's new in Build 154
notes.content:
Here's what's new in A Winding Path:

[list]
[*]Added three new color presets [i]Adrift in Dreams[/i], [i]Let them eat Cake![/i] and [i]That special T-Shirt.[/i]
[*] Improved community accessibility via main and pause menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Invitation to the Competition of Fine Archery
notes.content:
Respected Sir or Madam,

The [i]Cyclopean Archery Association[/i] would like to cordially invite you to the [i]Competition of Fine Archery[/i]. If you feel inclined to nock an arrow and show your skill, join us at the beautiful [i]Artemis Archery Club[/i] just outside the city of [i]Guildhaven[/i] in this test of aim, speed and perseverance. Together, let us celebrate this sophisticated sport and friendly rivalry!

And remember:
[i]No matter the number of eyes,
Every archer gets ten tries![/i]

With best wishes,
[i]Osonia Beifaren
President of the Cyclopean Archery Association[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/8841aa326e910e8de4d1d7d3a6cba6d404157fc3.gif[/img]

To enter the competition, head back to the Artemis Archery Club at the end of the game. You can also load a previous, finished playthrough.

Upon closer inspection, you will find that the following improvements have been made:
[list]
[*] The [i]Competition of Fine Archery[/i] is held at the Artemis Archery Club.
[*] Leaderboards show you the best times for 8, 9 and 10 targets hit, respectively.
[*] The [i]Competition of Fine Archery[/i] comes with a brand new set of 5 achievements.
[*] A round of [i]Fine Archery[/i] can be canceled with the pause menu button.
[*] Starting with a fresh set of arrows has never been easier: Just pick up the bow again!
[*] The keenest eyes might find additional small changes and improvements.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update. Please join us on [url=https://discord.gg/9dP4Bqb]Discord[/url] and let us know!
